definitions: To marry someone with whom one is already in a long-term relationship, especially when they are already living together and acting like a married couple.
To make a full commitment to a relationship, often implying marriage, when many of the benefits of that commitment are already being enjoyed without it.
examples: They've been living together for years, it's time he bought the cow.
Why buy the cow when you can get the milk for free?
After a decade of dating, she finally convinced him to buy the cow.
